```{R}
# Import libraries and files

library(deSolve)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

source("../models/two_seir_no_vacc.R")
source("../models/two_seir_vacc.R")
source("../models/seir_parms.R")
```

# Initial Experiments with Interference at 0.05
## Without Vaccination
```{R}

# Use ode function from deSolve package
out_no_vacc <- ode(y = no_vacc_init, times = times, func = seir_no_vacc, parms = cov_flu_parms)

plot(out_no_vacc)
```


```{R}
df <- as.data.frame(out_no_vacc)

# Combine A and B
df$A <- df$IS + df$IR
df$B <- df$SI + df$RI

df_long <- pivot_longer(df, cols = c(A, B),
                        names_to = "compartment", values_to = "count")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = time, y = count, color = compartment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Number of people", color = "Compartment") +
  theme_minimal()

```


## With Vaccination
```{R}

# Use ode function from deSolve package
out_vacc <- ode(y = vacc_init, times = times, func = seir_vacc, parms = cov_flu_vacc_parms)

plot(out_vacc)
```


```{R}
df <- as.data.frame(out_vacc)

# Combine A and B
df$A <- df$IS + df$IR + df$IV
df$B <- df$SI + df$RI + df$VI

df_long <- pivot_longer(df, cols = c(A, B),
                        names_to = "compartment", values_to = "count")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = time, y = count, color = compartment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Number of people", color = "Compartment") +
  theme_minimal()

```
